purpose: Preview concepts awaiting user selection; effects depicted as static frames.

options.name: Arcade Burst
options.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished UI concept comparison board by editing/recomposing the provided GET FUNDED game screenshot. The screenshot is the edit target and visual style reference: preserve its navy/cobalt trading screen, purple beveled controls, rounded thick white outlined Fredoka-style game typography, green/pink candlesticks. Focus on a new market-event announcement overlay. This is a concept preview only.
Output one high-resolution landscape design board. Two equally sized large panels SIDE BY SIDE, each showing a close crop of the EXISTING chart area and account-card bottom edge. Left panel is the upward event; right panel is downward event. The background chart remains visible, readable and visually secondary. No right-hand buy/sell panel needed in the crops. A narrow clean header across the board identifies the option. Keep the announcement in the upper third of each chart crop so most chart remains unobscured. Both notices are UI overlays, never baked into chart candles. Do not display profit amounts, guaranteed returns, timers, percentages, buy/sell advice, or fake buttons. No invented dashboard labels. Only exact requested text on the new overlay, professionally spaced. Render the effects as a beautiful paused animation frame. No browser chrome, device mockup, watermarks, perspective skew, illegible microtext. Crisp UI, not a poster.
Header text: "A · ARCADE BURST"
Design: energetic chunky beveled event card with dark navy interior, blue/purple rim and rounded corners. Card roughly 65% of each crop width, compact 110px-like height. Extruded shiny arrow badge overlapping left edge; vivid emerald UP arrow on left panel, hot coral/pink DOWN arrow on right. Giant readable heading in white with subtle green or pink outline. Surround the card with tightly controlled lightning streaks, glowing diamond sparks and short directional speed trails, only around the card. Emerald light under the surge card; magenta/coral light under selloff. A single gleaming light-sweep frozen across the top bevel. Fun polished Roblox game feel matching screenshot's 3D icons and vivid account cards, tasteful effects, no huge explosion obscuring chart.
Left card exact text: "MARKET SURGE" and smaller "Bullish market event".
Right card exact text: "MARKET SELLOFF" and smaller "Bearish market event".
Small labels outside the two panels underneath: "Spark burst · Arrow bounce · Light sweep".
